name: ffmpeg
description: Complete cross-platform solution to record, convert, and stream audio and video

ffmpeg.description: Audio/video transcoder and stream processor with extensive codec, filter, and container support
ffmpeg.usage:
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.mkv # Remux/convert container
ffmpeg -i input.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -c:a aac out.mp4 # H.264 encode
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf scale=1280:-2 scaled.mp4 # Resize keeping aspect
ffmpeg -i input.wav -c:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 out.mp3 # Extract/convert audio
ffmpeg -ss 00:00:10 -i input.mp4 -t 5 clip.mp4 # Cut a 5s clip from 10s

ffprobe.description: Media stream analyzer that reports format, codec, and metadata details for audio/video files
ffprobe.usage:
ffprobe input.mp4 # Show format and stream summary
ffprobe -v error -show_format -show_streams input.mkv # Full format/stream info
ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 input.mp4 # Print resolution
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=nw=1:nk=1 input.mp4 # Print duration

ffplay.description: Minimal media player built on FFmpeg libraries for quick playback and filter previewing
ffplay.usage:
ffplay input.mp4 # Play a media file
ffplay -autoexit -loglevel error clip.mkv # Play and exit at end, quiet
ffplay -vf scale=640:-2 input.mp4 # Preview with a scale filter
ffplay -f lavfi testsrc # Play a generated test source
